description: This file contains shell script functions related to preparing UBI devices and volumes for an OpenWrt-based system. It includes functions for attaching, removing, creating, and updating UBI volumes on specific devices, tailored for Buffalo hardware upgrades.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares UBI devices by removing specific volumes to reset state for OpenWrt installation.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_optvol
methods.description: Recreates essential UBI volumes and updates firmware hash volumes to validate system update readiness.
